name: Adult Bronze Dragon
summary: A huge metallic dragon that breathes lightning or a repulsion blast, casts sea and storm spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Repulsion Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/guiding-bolt}* (level 2 version).

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.onFailure: The target is pushed up to 60 feet straight away from the dragon and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

atWill.note: Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Guiding Light
items.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/guiding-bolt}* (level 2 version).

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed}, and it makes one Rend attack.

items.name: Thunderclap

save.targets: each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet

items.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/deafened} condition until the end of its next turn.
